## Introduction

I spent a lot of time working on modeling the movement of repair enzymes in DNA. For various reasons, publication of the results was delayed, but I wanted to share this derivation of the Berglund estimator of the diffusion constant [@RN44] and [@BerglundMichalet2012] as it took me so long to work out!.
